# Packages needed to run the tests in CI (Linux, CPU only, no AirSim).
# Versions are the same as in requirements-thesis.txt, with two Linux-specific changes:
# - torch and torchvision are installed separately as CPU builds (see .github/workflows/ci.yml);
# - opencv-contrib-python-headless replaces opencv-contrib-python (no GUI libraries on the runner).
# airsim, keyboard and msgpackrpc are not needed: the tests replace them with fakes.
